n, m, mod = map(int, input().split())

MAX = 505

dpA = [0] * MAX
dpB = [0] * MAX
dpC = [[0] * MAX for _ in range(MAX)]
dpD = [[0] * MAX for _ in range(MAX)]
C = [[0] * MAX for _ in range(MAX)]

# Precompute binomial coefficients
for i in range(MAX):
    C[i][0] = 1
    C[i][i] = 1
    for j in range(1, i):
        C[i][j] = (C[i-1][j] + C[i-1][j-1]) % mod

dpA[0] = 1
for i in range(1, MAX):
    # Compute dpA
    for j in range(1, n+1):
        sum_ = 0
        for k in range(1, j+1):
            sum_ = (sum_ + dpA[k-1] * dpA[i - k] % mod * C[i - 1][k - 1]) % mod
        dpA[i] = ((i + 1) * sum_) % mod

    # Compute dpB
    for j in range(1, n+1):
        sum2 = 0
        for k in range(1, j+1):
            temp1 = (dpA[k-1] * dpB[i - k] + dpB[k-1] * dpA[i - k]) % mod
            comb = C[i - 1][k - 1]
            sum2 = (sum2 + (i + 1) * comb % mod * temp1) % mod

            term = ((k * (k - 1) // 2) + ((i - k) * (i - k + 1) // 2)) % mod
            sum2 = (sum2 + comb * dpA[k - 1] % mod * dpA[i - k] % mod * term) % mod
        dpB[i] = sum2

# Compute dpC and dpD
dpC[0][0] = 1
for i in range(1, MAX):
    for j in range(i):
        val1 = dpC[i - 1][j]
        val2 = dpD[i - 1][j]
        for k in range(1, j + 1):
            t1 = (dpC[i - k - 1][j - k] * dpA[k] % mod * C[j][k]) % mod
            t2 = (dpC[i - k - 1][j - k] * dpB[k] % mod * C[j][k]) % mod
            t3 = (dpD[i - k - 1][j - k] * dpA[k] % mod * C[j][k]) % mod

            val1 = (val1 + t1) % mod
            val2 = (val2 + t2 + t3) % mod
        dpC[i][j] = val1
        dpD[i][j] = val2
    dpC[i][i] = dpA[i]
    dpD[i][i] = dpB[i]

print(dpD[n][m])
